questions.question: Magnesium gains mass when heated in air. Explain why and why total mass is conserved.
questions.modelAnswer:
Magnesium reacts with oxygen.
Oxygen atoms join the solid, increasing its measured mass.
In a closed system total reactant mass equals total product mass because atoms are rearranged, not created/destroyed.
markingPoints: Oxygen atoms join the solid, increasing its measured mass.
In a closed system total reactant mass equals total product mass because atoms are rearranged, not created/destroyed.

questions.question: Explain the difference between the 2 in 2H₂O and the 2 in H₂O. State the total number of hydrogen and oxygen atoms represented by 2H₂O.
questions.modelAnswer:
The large 2 is a coefficient: it means two water molecules/formula units.
The small 2 is a subscript: each water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms.
2H₂O contains 4 hydrogen atoms and 2 oxygen atoms in total.
markingPoints: The large 2 is a coefficient: it means two water molecules/formula units.
The small 2 is a subscript: each water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms.
2H₂O contains 4 hydrogen atoms and 2 oxygen atoms in total.

questions.question: What is the law of conservation of mass?
questions.modelAnswer: As no atoms are lost or made in a chemical reaction, the mass of the products will equal the mass of the reactants.
markingPoints: As no atoms are lost or made in a chemical reaction, the mass of the products will equal the mass of the reactants.
